outcome: SARS-CoV-2 entry proteins (ACE-2 and TMPRSS2) levels
CD8+ T-cell marker levels in EVs
Platelet activation marker (CD62P) levels in EVs
Endothelial marker EV-CD144+ levels in EVs
cohort: The study included 16 healthy non-pregnant women, 18 healthy pregnant women, and 22 pregnant women with COVID-19 in their third trimester.
finding: COVID-19 positive pregnant women had lower EV concentrations and an attenuated inflammatory response compared to healthy pregnant women, with no additional activation of the coagulation system.
